summary: Erickson Inc. is an American aircraft manufacturing and operating company headquartered in Portland, Oregon. Founded in 1971, it is known for the S-64 Aircrane helicopter, used in fire suppression and other heavy-lift work. The company was called Erickson Air-Crane Incorporated until 2014, and its main facility is in Central Point, Oregon.
one_line: Erickson Inc. is a Portland, Oregon aircraft maker founded in 1971, known for the S-64 Aircrane heavy-lift helicopter.
